title: Herodotus takes part in the Egyptian mystery cults and then stays silent about them

tellings.quote: Heroditus talks about these mystery cults in Egypt and he speculates on like I wonder what's going on here and then while he's in Egypt he's allowed to participate in them and then he doesn't talk about it again.

plain: The ancient Greek historian Herodotus wrote about secret religious rites in Egypt, the so-called mystery cults, and openly wondered what went on in them. Then, while he was in Egypt, he was allowed to take part, and after that he never spoke of them again. The researcher Luke Caverns tells this, citing Herodotus himself, as a sign that the Egyptians guarded knowledge that outsiders were sworn to keep quiet about.
